title: Joyed heals
description: You are all healed for your next journey!
body:
JoyedHeals – Instant Healing, Simplified

JoyedHeals is a lightweight and reliable healing plugin for Minecraft servers. Whether you’re helping players during events or offering staff tools for moderation, this plugin gets the job done with just one command.

 Features:
	•	/heal – Instantly restores your health, hunger, and saturation
	•	/heal [username] – Heal others with ease (admin command)
	•	Permission-based access:
	•	joyedheals.heal – Use /heal for yourself
	•	joyedheals.heal.others – Use /heal on other players

Perfect for survival servers, mini-games, or staff utility packs. Clean, fast, and no unnecessary clutter
